display.purpose: Landing hero headline and the closing sign-off title.

body.purpose: Running copy and accordion answers, max 68ch.

label.purpose: Condensed caps naming a field or a status.

reference.purpose: Form codes, line numbers, dates, pill tags.

entry.purpose: Values written by an agent or a person.

stat.purpose: The big number on an agent card.

shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: Every rounded panel: faint top light and a deep, diffuse fall-off.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: CSS state transitions: arrow nudge, nav underline, card lift, accordion, menu unroll. Mirrors GSAP expo.out.

motion.name: metal-sweep
motion.purpose: Highlight sweeping across pill buttons on hover and focus; off under reduced motion.

motion.name: button-lift
motion.value: translateY(-1px) scale(1.02) on hover, scale(0.98) on active, 0.35s ease-out

motion.name: aurora-drift
motion.value: 34s and 41s ease-in-out infinite alternate, translate up to 9vmax, scale 0.92 to 1.12
motion.purpose: Hero ambient light; off under reduced motion.

motion.name: spotlight
motion.value: 440px radial light, lerp 0.14 on requestAnimationFrame, fine pointers only

motion.name: accordion
motion.value: grid-template-rows 0fr to 1fr with opacity, 0.5s ease-out; toggle bar scaleY to 0 in 0.3s
motion.purpose: FAQ answers drop down on click.

motion.name: rail-wheel
motion.value: vertical wheel to horizontal glide, lerp 0.2; ignored within 380ms of page scroll; released at either end
motion.purpose: Agent strip browses under a resting pointer without taking over the page.

motion.name: rule-draw
motion.value: scaleX 0 to 1, 1.3s, expo.out, once at top 94%

motion.name: lines-rise
motion.value: SplitText masked lines, yPercent 108 to 0, 1.15s, stagger 0.085s, expo.out
motion.purpose: Headings rise out of their own baseline.

motion.name: rise
motion.value: opacity 0, y 26px, blur 6px to rest, 1s, stagger 0.08s, expo.out

motion.name: type
motion.value: characters revealed with 0.02s stagger (0.012s on the example schedule), linear

motion.name: stamp-press
motion.value: scale 1.9 to 1, rotation +16deg to rest, 0.55s, back.out(2.4)
motion.purpose: Stamps drop and press. The approval stamp uses scale 2.4 and back.out(2.8) plus a 2px jolt through the box.

motion.name: scrub-draw
motion.value: drawSVG scrubbed from top 72% to bottom 55%
motion.purpose: The signature and long connectors ink with the scroll.

motion.name: lenis
motion.value: lerp 0.11, anchor offset -96px, fine pointers only
motion.purpose: Smooth scroll on pointer devices; off for touch and reduced motion.

motion.name: motion-gate
motion.value: html.motion set before paint unless prefers-reduced-motion; html.motion-done after 4s if the choreographer never starts
motion.purpose: Content is visible by default; entrance states apply only once motion is opted in.

narrative.overview:
The site opens on light, not paper: an interactive Spline robot on the right of the hero, slow aurora drifting behind the headline, and a soft spotlight that follows the cursor. Below it, every section sits on a rounded navy panel with a faint border and a soft shadow, so the page reads as a sequence of calm, gently lifted surfaces rather than a ruled form. The insurance document survives where it earns its place: typed mono entries, condensed field labels, round rubber stamps, and one approval box that always belongs to the visitor.

Density is relaxed. Panels breathe (56px by 48px of padding on desktop), dividers are faint and appear only where they help reading, and nothing is boxed in for the sake of it. Corners are soft everywhere: 28px on panels, 36px on agent cards, full pills on buttons, tags and toggles. Motion is fluid and continuous: aurora drift, a spotlight that glides, a metallic highlight sweeping across buttons, headings rising by line, entries typing, stamps pressing.

The brand palette is fixed and blue-only. Ice is the brightest note on any screen and signals live, approved or promised states; elsewhere it appears only as light inside metal and glow.
keyCharacteristics: Rounded everything: panels 28px, cards 36px, fields 14px, buttons, tags and toggles fully round.
Soft navy panels with a faint border and a soft ambient shadow; no crop marks, section folios, printed strips or ruled margins.
Interactive robot hero with aurora drift and a cursor spotlight, desktop only and never under reduced motion.
Liquid-metal pill buttons with a sweeping highlight.
The document survives as detail: Martian Mono entries, condensed caps labels, rubber stamps, the visitor's approval box.
Pilot and coming-soon items are dimmed with ghost stamps, never dressed as live.

rules.name: The Earned Ice Rule
rules.body: Ice as a colour of text, fill or stamp means live, approved, or one of the hero's promises (plus the focus ring and caret). Ice may also appear as light inside button metal and the cursor spotlight. It is never a decorative fill or a heading colour.

rules.name: The One Gradient Word Rule
rules.body: Every marketing title carries exactly one emphasised word in the white-to-ice-to-accent gradient (100deg, white 0%, ice 46%, accent 100%). Never two, never a whole line.

rules.name: The Fixed Stock Rule
rules.body: The palette is the brand's and is closed. Tints are made by opacity on existing tokens, not by new hex values.

rules.name: The Typed Entry Rule
rules.body: Mono means written onto the document: entries, references, codes, dates and line numbers. Headlines, body, questions and buttons are never mono.

rules.name: The Field Label Rule
rules.body: Condensed caps name a field or a status. They never introduce a heading as a stacked line above it.

rules.name: The Header Row Rule
rules.body: A form code or reference inside a panel sits in a header row paired with a counterpart on the right (a breadcrumb or a date), not alone above a heading.

rules.name: The Soft Light Rule
rules.body: Shadows are diffuse and blue or navy, with large blur and negative spread. Never a hard offset shadow.

rules.name: The Soft Corner Rule
rules.body: Nothing that holds content has a sharp corner. Containers start at 14px; anything tag-like or pressable is a full pill.

dos: Do set every content section on a rounded panel: 28px corners, soft navy gradient, faint border, panel shadow.
Do make every button a liquid-metal pill, and every tag, toggle and small control fully round.
Do keep ice for live, approved and the hero's promises, plus the focus ring, caret and the light inside metal.
Do set exactly one gradient word per title.
Do set anything typed (entries, codes, dates, line numbers) in Martian Mono, and field labels in 72%-width Archivo caps.
Do dim pilot and coming-soon items to 75% with ghost stamps and outlined status marks.
Do tag demonstration content with the "Example" pill so nothing reads as a claim.
Do keep FAQ answers folded until the question is clicked.
Do keep the robot desktop-only and off under reduced motion; the aurora carries the hero everywhere else.
Do keep content visible by default: entrance states apply only after the motion gate opts in, reduced motion skips all of it, and a 4s fallback restores everything if the choreographer never starts.
donts: Don't use sharp corners or square boxes on anything that holds content.
Don't outline every part: no registration crop marks, section folios, printed top strips, ruled paper or margin rules. Dividers stay faint and only where they help reading.
Don't add colours outside the fixed brand palette.
Don't dress a pilot or coming-soon item as live (no ice, no blue stamp, no full opacity).
Don't show FAQ answers open by default on the landing page.
Don't use em dashes in any typeset copy, and don't set titles that address brokers directly.
